summary: The enclosure is visually coherent and the two side panels use dense staggered round-hole fields with continuous borders. However, the available renders do not directly establish the detailed motherboard, cooler, GPU, PSU, and power-button routing interfaces, and the side-panel orthographic view shows several horizontal seam lines crossing hole rows, so panel integrity is not accepted.

checks.description: The focused isometric, front, and top views show a complete, proportionate tower enclosure with aligned shell panels and installed fit bodies; no obvious floating exterior part or gross collision is visible.

evidence.description: The isometric overview visibly shows the principal enclosure and fit objects arranged as one coherent assembly without an obvious detached component.

checks.description: The overview indicates an internal motherboard fit body, but the render does not directly expose all mounting points or demonstrate accessible rear I/O, so the full interface cannot be verified visually.

evidence.description: The enclosure overview provides context, but its closed-shell presentation does not visibly establish retention at the Mini-ITX mounting pattern or rear-I/O accessibility.

checks.description: The focused render shows the cooler envelope in the assembly, but the side-panel intake gap is not directly discernible enough to prove preserved clearance.

evidence.description: The AXP120-X67 fit body is visible in enclosure context, but the image does not resolve a measurable or unambiguous gap to the intake panel.

checks.description: The rear GPU, mount, riser slot, and reserved bend volume are represented, but the views do not directly prove I/O bracket access, an unobstructed riser path, and usable cable-bend space together.

evidence.description: The focused GPU-side context is visible, but occlusion prevents direct confirmation of every required access and routing feature.

checks.description: The PSU fit body and cradle are shown, but the available views do not directly establish AC-inlet access, airflow, retention, and unobstructed harness routing as a complete interface.

evidence.description: The PSU installation region is visible, while the inlet, retention details, and full cable route remain insufficiently exposed.

checks.description: An exterior button location is visible, but the render does not continuously expose and prove the internal lead path to the motherboard header.

evidence.description: The front view supports external button accessibility, but it cannot show termination of the internal route at the motherboard header.

checks.description: Both side panels visibly use dense, regular circular perforations in staggered rows rather than horizontal slots, and each array remains inside a continuous perimeter frame.

evidence.description: The left orthographic view directly shows a dense staggered circular-hole field bounded on all sides by a frame.
The right orthographic view directly shows the matching round-hole pattern and continuous perimeter border.

checks.description: Although the circular holes retain visible webs and stay inside the outer frame, several horizontal seam/intersection lines visibly cross complete hole rows in the side orthographic render; this is a concrete surface-integrity defect that prevents accepting the panel as free of broken faces or unintended intersections.

evidence.description: Multiple horizontal lines visibly pass through circular holes across the panel, contradicting the requirement for a clean uninterrupted perforated face.

checks.description: The front, top, rear, feet, button, and both perforated side panels visibly form a consistent upright ITX enclosure; no obvious external interpenetration is visible in the multi-angle exterior views.

evidence.description: The isometric exterior view shows a closed, aligned tower shell with top, front/rear structure, side panel, and feet reading as one enclosure.
The rear isometric view shows the opposite side panel, base, feet, and rear structure meeting coherently without an obvious exterior collision.
